mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_group (group_code, name, description, status) VALUES (#{groupCode}, #{name}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_code, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at FROM code_group WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, group_code, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at FROM code_group WHERE group_code = #{groupCode}
SELECT id, group_code, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at FROM code_group ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM code_group WHERE id = #{id})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM code WHERE group_code = #{groupCode})
